name: Flatten Base
author: PolyPal
description: Squashes the lowest part of a model onto a flat plane so it stands and prints without supports.

editor.label: Flatten Base
editor.description: Press the bottom of the model flat for printing or standing upright.

params_schema.label: Flatten height (%)
params_schema.tooltip: How much of the model's height, measured from the bottom, is pressed onto the base plane.
